en.content: In a school, there are three types of games to be played. Some of the students play two types of games, but none play all the three games. Which Venn diagrams can justify the above statement?
en.explanation:
As none play all three games the intersection of all three circles must be zero.

Hence none of P, Q, R justify the given statement
